title: Conditional κ = 0.0036502223357 (+>2.21881616e-7 over #7603)
body:
The exact published #7603 word leaves productive helper 315 unobserved between its `729→789→808` moves (78 intervening events). Replace the two rank-one moves with one rank-two move at the later position. This preserves its arbitrary-input identity and productive target while changing the complete 17-call bill by **ΔP₁=−34, ΔP₂=+17**: paid positions fall from 110,400 to 110,383; 22,461 productive positions and rank surplus 1,424 remain unchanged.

The new **conditional κ = 0.0036502223357** exceeds #7603's certified raw-crossing upper bound `0.003650000454084` by **more than 2.21881616e−7**. The exact moment improvement is `17(2−2^(1−C))>0` for `0<C<1`. Directed bounds enclose the new crossing in `(0.0036502223358272, 0.0036502223358273)`; a negative derivative certificate establishes uniqueness on the inherited BIT interval. The fixed-scalar fusion family with no intervening access has one candidate before this edit and none afterward. This is a scoped ceiling, not a general optimization barrier.

Validation in `research/p104-role315-direct-lift`:

- Independently implemented forward and reverse rational replay of #7546 → #7601 → #7603 → candidate: all 1,569 final rows and 74 erased rows agree. Helper 315 identity/target, owned lifetimes, grid and fixed caller charges are checked. Four rejecting controls also pass under optimized Python.
- All 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns of the new map, including absolute phase and rank; 35 affected lineage pairs receive the same checks. Wrong chart, omitted paid work and phase controls reject.
- Fresh complete native/signed application: 3,039 catalogue maps, 104 boundary pairs, 17 native calls, all 54 strict + 4 functional outer predicates. Ordinary bound `782716348 < 10^9`, precision factor 2430, full tape accounting recomputed. The public claim is a conservative weakening of the fully checked framework claim `0.003650222335827`; public-gate tape inequalities also pass.
- Exact-source authentication of 100 retained files against their original Git commits. Published #7603 archive members are checked without a foreign-history dependency. All six registered commands passed on Python 3.12.16 (macOS arm64); fresh native/signed stages took 124.74/142.32 seconds. Reproduce with: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-role315-direct-lift`.

Sources and credit: SYLforge #7603 at `3f031ccb7ae7229a7323b1601877f24a46dfcf57` supplies both preceding contractions and removal of the 315 reads; DreamingOfClouds #7601 at `eccf3d1fe814ea86a373d37a783105ceb853c390` supplies token settlement; ToikY #7546 at `99438c43df7aac1e5dbcc43c1578fcd886c119ec` supplies the complete predecessor application. Rohan Arun's #7113 caller and the retained lineage keep their notices. Prepared by Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separately scoped derivation/application reviews. Initial concurrent 166-only work was superseded by #7603 and is not claimed as novel here. [Canonical investigation and overlap updates](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19613348).

Five assumptions remain: `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`. This is a source-bound conditional improvement with finite replay, not a formal-kernel or unconditional multiplication theorem. No selected-result, shared-code or frozen-predecessor changes. Exact environment, receipts, registered replay outcome and CI limitations are recorded in VALIDATION.md.

Shared CI limitation: the unchanged base reproduces `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` failing because docs/ci.md names #6030 while selected-result.json names #7000 (5 other tests pass). Existing #7276 addresses this; this PR does not duplicate the repair. Local research-package replay is fully passing; hosted planning/replay status must be read separately.
